verification_note: Capability claims were compiled from each project's official repository, documentation site and release notes. Evidence links point at canonical official sources. Claims about features a competitor LACKS were only recorded where absence is documented or structurally implied by the project's stated scope; where absence could not be confirmed the field is null rather than false. Re-verify before quoting in external material.

competitors.name: Nix / Nix Flakes
competitors.activity: Very active; large maintainer team and frequent releases
competitors.audience: Individual developers through large infrastructure teams; NixOS users
competitors.deployment_model: Local daemon + shared binary cache; optional caches (cache.nixos.org, Cachix)

cli_sdk_api.api: JSON output modes for some commands

competitors.plugins_extensions: Flakes/overlays ecosystem instead of a plugin API
competitors.self_hosting_offline: Full offline builds possible with local caches/mirrors
competitors.security_privacy: Content-addressed store, sandboxed builds, signed paths
competitors.commercial_boundary: None in core; Cachix/Determinate Systems sell hosted services
strengths: strongest reproducibility guarantees in the space
we_do_better: read-only diagnosis without requiring any installation or daemon
explains PATH resolution and shadowing across managers
privacy-sanitized shareable snapshots and semantic machine-to-machine diffs
works across Windows/macOS/Linux including machines where Nix is absent
gaps_worth_closing: emit Nix-compatible diagnostics hints when a flake.nix exists
parse flake.lock inputs for version expectations
not_worth_copying: becoming a package manager or build system

competitors.name: devenv
competitors.audience: Developers wanting Nix power with simpler ergonomics
competitors.deployment_model: Local; built on Nix; devenv.sh processes/services runner
competitors.commercial_boundary: Core open source; Cachix sells binary caching
we_do_better: diagnoses whether a devenv setup will work on THIS machine
gaps_worth_closing: detect devenv installations and validate devenv.yaml/devenv.lock consistency

competitors.name: Devbox (Jetify)
competitors.audience: Teams wanting Nix-backed environments without learning Nix
competitors.deployment_model: Local CLI + Nix under the hood; cloud shell product separate
competitors.commercial_boundary: Devbox CLI open source; Jetify Cloud commercial
weaknesses: no diagnostics of host machine health
gaps_worth_closing: detect devbox.json projects and validate lock freshness
flag nix installation problems that break devbox

competitors.name: mise
competitors.self_hosting_offline: Tool downloads cached locally; mirror support
competitors.security_privacy: Checksum verification for some backends; otherwise standard download trust
weaknesses: does not diagnose the rest of the machine
we_do_better: machine-wide view across ALL managers incl. mise itself
explainable precedence and conflicts between managers
gaps_worth_closing: detect mise shims shadowing other installs

competitors.name: asdf
competitors.deployment_model: Local; shim-based; git clone plugin model (legacy) or Go-native
competitors.security_privacy: Standard download trust; some plugins verify checksums
we_do_better: cross-manager conflict detection (asdf vs nvm vs system)
gaps_worth_closing: detect asdf shims in PATH analysis

competitors.name: direnv
we_do_better: diagnoses .envrc status/authorization issues without executing it
gaps_worth_closing: report direnv hook presence and .envrc allow state

competitors.name: Dev Containers (spec + CLI)
competitors.license: Creative Commons / MIT samples; CLI MIT (open source)
competitors.deployment_model: Container runtime required (Docker/Podman); editor integration (VS Code/JetBrains)
competitors.security_privacy: Standard container security; image trust is user-managed
enterprise_features: prebuilds at scale via commercial products (GitHub Codespaces)
weaknesses: no host-machine diagnosis beyond container runtime
we_do_better: checks whether the HOST can actually run the declared devcontainer
gaps_worth_closing: discover devcontainer.json and validate host compatibility
generate draft devcontainer.json from explicit requirements

competitors.name: DevPod
competitors.activity: Active (Loft Labs / acquired by VMware-Broadcom lineage)
competitors.audience: Developers wanting disposable cloud/local dev containers
competitors.deployment_model: Local client + providers (docker, k8s, cloud VMs)
enterprise_features: integrates with Loft vCluster ecosystem commercially
competitors.commercial_boundary: Core open source; enterprise via Loft products
gaps_worth_closing: detect DevPod installations and workspace configs where relevant

competitors.name: Coder (and similar cloud IDE platforms: Ona/Gitpod lineage, Daytona)
competitors.license: AGPL-3.0 core (open source) with enterprise tier
competitors.audience: Engineering organizations centralizing remote dev environments
competitors.deployment_model: Self-hosted server + workspaces on cloud infra
platforms: server: Linux; clients: all desktop OS
enterprise_features: RBAC, audit, high availability, support (enterprise license)
competitors.commercial_boundary: AGPL core; Enterprise license for advanced features
weaknesses: operates workspaces, does not diagnose developer laptops
we_do_better: local-first single-user value with zero infrastructure
gaps_worth_closing: model for our self-hosted mode: org/project/RBAC/audit patterns

competitors.name: Doctor-style utilities (flutter doctor, brew doctor, cargo doctor, winget doctor)
we_do_better: stable exit codes and JSON everywhere
safe remediation planning with risk levels
